verdict.rationale: Netlify is an edge and serverless platform, so offering a persistent agent runtime is a fair question for it, but the evidence documents no persistent runtime environment for coding agents and no automatic state checkpointing. Dashboard-prompted AI agents, deploy rollbacks and blob storage are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not this capability.

support.subject: As an ai-native builder, I can give my coding agent a persistent runtime environment that checkpoints its state automatically while working
